f: Neither Ingrid nor Heather had business experience or taken business classes. They received free consulting from the Small Business Development Center in Bellingham, which provided personal business assistance. They researched IV hydration clinics in Washington State, Oregon, and California, reached out to other business owners, pretended to be patients to understand the customer experience, and consulted with pharmacists. Their decision was largely based on gut feeling, observing Bellingham's health-conscious culture and active population, and recognizing the business opportunity when no competitor had opened in three years despite the nationwide growth of IV hydration clinics.
d9ea2787c7.rq: If we're providing a good product, really take care of and listen to our clients, take care of your employees—that should be it, right? That's what you should have for a good business.
ks: Ingrid has been practicing family medicine in Bellingham for 13 years
Heather spent nearly 20 years in ER and ICU hospital care
Ingrid saw the IV hydration concept on the south coast of Mississippi over 10 years ago
Peak Hydration opened in approximately 3-4 months from decision to launch
Heather waited 3 years after moving to Bellingham in 2018 before starting Peak Hydration, expecting a competitor to open first
en: Peak Hydration IV Therapy & Wellness Lounge

f9f1c35edd.q: What was Ingrid Nishiyama's motivation for leaving traditional family medicine to co-found Peak Hydration?
f9f1c35edd.a: Ingrid felt there was a missing component in her family practice—the ability to bring in other service lines like nutritionists, strength training coaches, and nurses who could provide regular feedback and a widespread approach to healthcare. She was frustrated that care was driven by insurance denials rather than what patients actually needed. She wanted to continue her preventive health role in the way she felt it should be done, not as forced by insurance companies.

3bce0613e1.q: How did Heather Honey overcome her fear of business failure when starting Peak Hydration?
3bce0613e1.a: Heather went through cycles of resentment and naturally pessimistic thinking, but her boss at the time believed in the idea and validated it by saying 'let's do it.' Her husband was also supportive, telling her 'what if it fails, who cares?' He helped her reframe failure as acceptable. Heather changed her mindset to think 'even if it does fail, I didn't fail—we successfully opened a business and successfully tried.' This psychological reframing, combined with someone believing in her, helped her move forward despite her fear.

85e6bf95b2.q: What was Heather Honey's frustration with the nursing profession that led to starting her own business?
85e6bf95b2.a: Heather observed that in the medical system, physicians are paid based on what they do, so when a nurse works harder, the physician makes more money, but the nurse remains an hourly employee making no more despite working twice as hard. She realized that if she was going to work this hard, why not do it for herself? This inequity in compensation structure, despite her driving and hardworking nature, motivated her entrepreneurial shift.
